notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes: [p]Your feedback makes the game better! Today we released a major update based on your most important requests. For example, the diary now always opens on the last page you closed it on.[/p][p] [/p][h2]List of changes in patch 1.2:[/h2][p] [/p][h3]Bugs:[/h3][p]1) Fixed a bug that caused a green stripe to appear at the bottom of the screen.[/p][p]2) Fixed a bug with an inactive chest in the “Village” location.[/p][p]3) Fixed a bug on the “Village” map when interacting with Stepan Razin's well.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Content:[/h3][p]1) A section with finds has been added to the main menu — now you can collect items.[/p][p]2) A section with interesting notes on anomalous zones has been added to the main menu — real quotes from tourists who visited the Zhigulevsky Mountains.[/p][p]3) A “Read” button has been added to the diary.[/p][p]4) The mechanism for displaying content in the diary has been improved.[/p][p]5) Now the diary opens on the page where it was closed.[/p][p]6) A visual display of the saving process has been added.[/p][p]7) The speed of backpack searches has been increased.[/p][p]8) Changes have been made to the “Cave” map to improve the gaming experience.[/p][p]9) Additional environment elements have been added to the “Village” map.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Now is the time to play Temple of the Green Moon, if you haven't already![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes: [p]We support the game, analyze feedback, and regularly release updates. Today, the project received a global patch.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Fixes:[/h2][p]1) Fixed some save points.[/p][p]2) Fixed issues with the lantern.[/p][p]3) Fixed issues with the door in the hut at the “Shore” location.[/p][p]4) Added additional collisions to prevent the most cunning players from getting through.[/p][p]5) Fixed phrases spoken by the fortune teller in the “Village” location and added subtitles to them[/p][p]6) Fixed the incorrectly working “Superman” achievement[/p][p]7) Fixed some subtitles in the “Cave” that were not working correctly[/p][p] [/p][h2]Content additions:[/h2][p]1) Replaced the actor's reaction to fear to immerse the player more in the atmosphere.[/p][p]2) Made the monster's appearance in the “Dungeon” location more varied.[/p][p]3) Added a newspaper clipping to the “Village” location that reveals more about the lore of these places.[/p][p]4) Removed 2 hatches in the “Cave” location at the request of players.[/p][p]5) Added a very interesting magazine, you will definitely like it if you find it 😊.[/p][p]6) Worked on the sounds in the “Cave” for a better atmosphere.[/p][p]7) Added additional content to the diary, which will immerse you even more in the story.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Thank you for your comments, streams, and reviews. It means a lot to our team! We appreciate every word and work hard for you![/b][/p]

notes.title: The long-awaited release!
notes.notes: [p]We are happy to announce that the game has been officially released on Steam. Friends, play, enjoy, share your emotions, impressions of the game, reviews, beautiful screenshots, and your thoughts![/p][p] [/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who has supported us over the past two years. It has been a long but interesting journey![/p][p] [/p][p]We are continuing to work on the project: additional content and minor improvements are coming soon. You can polish a game to perfection endlessly.[/p][p] [/p][p]We work for you.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]- The Olkon Games team[/b][/p]

notes.title: The release is coming soon!
notes.notes: [p]Friends, the game is technically ready for release and is undergoing final testing. We want to add as much content as possible before release.[/p][p] [/p][p]The Steam release is coming soon! Temple of the Green Moon will be out in early September. Are you ready to embark on a mystical adventure with Max?[/p]

notes.title: The demo update is now on Steam!
notes.notes:
Some players noted the measured pace of the demo. But we generally considered it as a demonstration of mechanics: the main game will be different. Anyway, to please you, we added dynamics to the current version of the demo.

[u]The list of updates is already waiting for you in Steam:[/u]
[b]✅ Interface:[/b]
- tourist's memo added to the main menu
- changed graphics settings in the settings
- added disabling subtitles

[b]✅ Content:[/b]
- added another monster and battle with it
- added another ghost
- added new sounds, corrected previous sounds
- added animated spiders on the web on the locations
- fixed some textures
- reduced time of backpack loot
- expanded safe zones
- added opening/closing of chests
- corrected effects when a character dies

[b]✅ Errors:[/b]
- fixed a possible error when looting a backpack with an empty flashlight

[b]Download the update! We look forward to your feedback to help improve the project![/b]
